classification.description: What kind of issue this is.

routed_to_rate_flow.description: True when the fix would change how tax is calculated. Those tickets stop at diagnosis here and go to the staged rate-fix flow.

observed_behavior.description: What the system actually does, and how that was observed.

likely_cause.description: The most likely cause, hedged to the evidence available.

pr_url.description: PR URL if a fix shipped, else empty. Must be empty when routed_to_rate_flow is true.

jira_comment_posted.description: Whether the product-level Jira comment was posted.
